mod23_unit6b_availability_B2_proxy_2011_.description: Base model with rolling team inputs adjusted for own QB snap share in each past game, paired vs base, 2011-2019; 1150-1081 vs 1142-1089.
mod23_unit6b_availability_B2_proxy_2011_.notes: Two arms (continuous own-QB dose; plus own non-QB starter absences), two eras (four accuracy looks); snap counts of completed games; coefficients fit on earlier seasons only.
mod23_unit6b_availability_B2_proxy_2011_.plain_summary: Discounting past games by how much of the lineup was missing gave a small unresolved change in picks against the opener.
